# Contributors to never credit in package.json.
#
# One entry per line. A line may be:
#   - an email:          someone@example.com
#   - a name:            Some Person
#   - a full identity:   Some Person <someone@example.com>
#
# '#' starts a comment and blank lines are ignored. Matching is
# case-insensitive: an identity is skipped when its email OR its name matches an
# entry here.
#
# This is the escape hatch for the authors workflow. Because that workflow
# derives the contributor list from git history, deleting a contributor's entry
# from package.json gets undone on the next push -- list it here instead.
